title: Overseas Slots as Scarce Assets: How Should Mumbai Indians Allocate Four Places?
dek: Four overseas places, one cap. How should Mumbai Indians allocate the scarcest seats in the eleven? Spend and contribution by nationality frame the decision.
excerpt: Since 2018, overseas players have taken a share of Mumbai Indians' spend that the data can set against their share of the action. The four slots are the most constrained resource in any IPL squad.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: Overseas players took {{ev:os-spend}} of Mumbai Indians' recorded spend since 2018.
They faced or bowled {{ev:os-balls}} of the side's balls.
Total tempo runs above average: {{ev:os-traa}} from overseas players, {{ev:os-itraa}} from Indian players.

sections.heading: The Four-Seat Constraint
body: An IPL eleven can include at most four overseas players. That makes each overseas seat a scarce asset: an overseas player who is merely average blocks a place that a match-winner could have filled.
Since 2018, overseas players have taken {{ev:os-spend}} of Mumbai Indians' recorded spend and faced or bowled {{ev:os-balls}} of the side's balls.

sections.heading: What the Seats Produced
body: Measured in tempo runs above average, overseas players contributed {{ev:os-traa}} for MI over the period and Indian players {{ev:os-itraa}}.

sections.heading: Allocating the Four
body: The best use of an overseas seat is a role the domestic pool cannot fill: express pace, wrist spin, or a top-order hitter with a proven T20 record. Overseas players who duplicate available Indian skills waste the seat.
For MI, each overseas signing should be justified by the role it fills that no available Indian player can.

sections.heading: Nationality Data Is Imperfect
body: Nationality comes from player-bio records where available and from squad lists otherwise; the squad lists contain known errors. A few players may be misclassified.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Spend the Seats on Scarcity
body: Mumbai Indians should judge overseas seats on the scarce role each fills, not on reputation. Contribution per seat, tracked each season, shows which seats are earning their place.
The role-scarcity analysis identifies the roles worth an overseas seat.

seo.metaTitle: Overseas slots as scarce assets at MI
seo.metaDescription: How much Mumbai Indians spend on overseas players since 2018, how much of the action they get, and what they contribute.

methodology: Contribution is tempo runs above average (tRAA): batting runs above what an average batter would score from the same balls in the same season and phase, plus bowling runs saved against the average bowler in the same season and phase. Wickets and dismissals are not valued in this version. Prices come from CricField squad lists (₹ crore = 100 lakh). Generated by scripts/editorial/engine. Nationality from player-bio data, with squad lists as fallback.
